site_name: Fourth and Fifth Floor Flat, 53 Cadogan Square, LONDON, SW1X 0HY
description: Amendments to the previously granted listed building consent LB/20/07063 (Replacement of three sash windows on front elevation, two sash windows on rear elevation, sliding doors on fifth floor front and rear elevations and sliding doors to rear elevation of fourth floor. Alteration and enlargement of roof-lights in roof space over fifth floor to create one continuous lantern roof-light within roof profile. Installation of low profile roof light above kitchen location including replacement of roof-light. Removal of raised terraced section. Internal refurbishment with modifications and upgrades including internal layout changes and repositioning of staircase.) to allow changes to 4th and 5th staircase; changes to WC and utility, and approved rooflights
